name: Balmer Lawrie Investment Ltd
description: AboutBalmer Lawrie Investments Ltd is a Government Enterprise. It’s a major stakeholder of Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd. The company along with its subsidiaries is engaged in the business of Industrial Packaging, Greases & Lubricants, Leather Chemicals, etc.[1]Key PointsFormation of Company[1]As part of oil sector deregulation, the Government of India disinvested~33.6% fromIBP (Indo Burma Petrol) Co (from ~60% holding) and demerged IBP’s stake in Balmer Lawrie & Company Ltd to Balmer Lawrie Investments Ltd (incorporated in 2001). The President of India currently holds ~60% equity in the company, which operates under the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas.Read MoreWebsiteBSENSE
